summary: Alerts from the scan of X, which runs every 5 minutes by day and every 30 minutes overnight (3:00 am to 9:00 am Singapore time). Event time is when the incident happened, which can differ from when it was reported; it says not stated when sources don't give it. Counts and the net read cover the rolling last 24 hours; the feed lists all stored alerts.

netRead.lead: Net read (last 24 hours): supply risk stays elevated, with overnight explosions reported off Qeshm and Bandar Lengeh and a CIA push to keep the "no war, no deal" pressure on Iran, even as Trump and Vance signal no rush to resume strikes.
netRead.text: Twenty-two of the twenty-eight alerts in the last 24 hours point to higher prices: an Axios report that CIA Director Ratcliffe is advising Trump to keep the "no war, no deal" status quo and let economic pressure on Iran continue (unconfirmed), Fars reporting explosions off Bandar Lengeh as seven USAF aerial refueling tankers, an AWACS and a P-8 operate over Hormuz, a reported explosion at sea southwest of Qeshm Island with an unconfirmed OSINT claim that the IRGC is attacking vessels in the Strait of Hormuz with anti-ship missiles or drones, IRNA reports of five loud explosions on Iran's Qeshm Island and blasts in Bandar Abbas, with unconfirmed reports of US strikes on Iranian air defenses, an IRGC claim that it shot down a US MQ-9 Reaper over the eastern Strait of Hormuz and two MQM-170 drones near Qeshm, President Zelenskyy warning that Russia is preparing a new massive attack on Ukraine's energy and logistics, a ship struck in the Strait of Hormuz off Oman (UKMTO 193-26), President Trump saying he is in no hurry to end the US naval blockade and economic pressure on Iran, an explosion and large fire at HPCL's Visakh refinery in India, a Houthi claim of drone strikes on Dammam airport in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province and on targets in Jizan (unverified), Kazakhstan halting oil flows on the Atyrau-Samara pipeline (some reports cite a drone attack), reported explosions and gunfire at the British Embassy in Baghdad (per Tasnim, unconfirmed), an Iranian navy report that a tanker with its navigation systems off hit a mine and caught fire in the eastern Strait of Hormuz, an IRGC claim that 11 tankers have burned in Hormuz since Oct 25, a headline that the start of Iran-US negotiations depends on ending the US naval blockade, Iran saying Hormuz cannot reopen before US sanctions are lifted, an IRGC claim that four oil tankers exploded on an unauthorized Hormuz route, a tanker in Hormuz disabled by limpet mines that sources name as the Louise 1, a tanker struck in the northern Gulf east of Ras Al Khafji, Saudi-led airstrikes on the Houthis' Ras Isa fuel terminal, Saudi civil defense warnings in Abha, Khamis Mushait and Taif amid a reported Houthi attack, and a reported Ukrainian drone strike on Transneft's Samara crude hub. The six offsets are President Trump telling Axios he is in no rush to decide whether to resume fighting in Iran (with VP Vance saying no deadline is set to resume strikes), a Kan News report that Saudi Arabia told Tehran no attacks on Iran will be launched from its territory or airspace (unconfirmed), President Trump saying an Iran deal is coming together nicely and that's why oil is down, a report from diplomatic sources to Lebanon's Al Jadeed of a breakthrough in US-Iran talks after Qatari mediation (unconfirmed), President Pezeshkian saying the Supreme Leader has given the government authority over negotiations, and a WSJ report that Washington is pushing to restore Russian gas flows to Europe via Ukraine as part of an energy truce.

brent.detail: Brent futures settled at $104.77/bbl, down $8.66 (7.63%), as US-Iran diplomacy eased supply fears, per LiveSquawk around 3:53 am SGT, 3 Nov

alerts.headline: Axios: CIA Director Ratcliffe is advising Trump to keep the "no war, no deal" status quo with Iran and let the economic pressure campaign continue, arguing prolonged pain will force more Iranian concessions
alerts.source: Barak Ravid (Axios), citing sources

alerts.headline: Iran's Fars reports explosions heard off the coast of Bandar Lengeh in the Strait of Hormuz, as trackers see seven USAF aerial refueling tankers, an AWACS and a P-8 patrol plane over Hormuz and the Gulf of Oman, fuelling talk of new US strikes
alerts.source: Fars via Visioner; BashaReport and UK Report flight tracking

alerts.headline: Explosion reported at sea southwest of Iran's Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz; an OSINT account says the IRGC is attacking vessels in the strait with anti-ship cruise missiles or drones
alerts.source: AMK Mapping and FromIran via local reports

alerts.headline: Iran's IRNA reports five loud explosions on Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz, with residents seeing two aircraft overhead and more blasts reported in Bandar Abbas; unconfirmed reports say US strikes hit Iranian air defenses
alerts.source: FaytuksNetwork, Visioner and War Monitor, citing IRNA and local witnesses

alerts.headline: IRGC claims it shot down a US MQ-9 Reaper drone (its 55th) over the eastern Strait of Hormuz and brought down two US MQM-170 reconnaissance drones near Qeshm Island using electronic warfare
alerts.source: IRGC claim, relayed by MenchOsint, Open Source Intel and Iran Nuances

alerts.headline: Kan News: Saudi Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman told Tehran in person that no attacks on Iran will be launched from Saudi territory or airspace, in return for Iran leaving the kingdom alone
alerts.source: Open Source Intel and Post Open Source citing Kan News

alerts.headline: President Trump tells Axios he is 'in no rush' to decide whether to resume fighting in Iran, letting talks play out; VP Vance says some progress made and no deadline set to resume strikes
alerts.source: Barak Ravid (Axios), OSINTdefender and LiveSquawk

alerts.headline: President Zelenskyy says Ukraine has intel that Russia is preparing a new massive attack primarily targeting Ukraine's energy and logistics, timed for the US midterms
alerts.source: Volodymyr Zelenskyy (official account)

alerts.headline: President Trump says an Iran deal is 'coming together nicely, that's why oil is down', adding that Iran asked the US to stop killing its leaders and 'we will'
alerts.source: Zerohedge and Giovanni Staunovo relaying Trump remarks

alerts.headline: UKMTO Warning 193-26: a ship has been struck in the Strait of Hormuz off the coast of Oman, the latest in a run of attacks on Gulf shipping; vessel and damage not yet stated
alerts.source: UKMTO Operations Centre on X, relayed by Israel War Room and Post Open Source

alerts.headline: President Trump says he is in no hurry to end the US naval blockade and economic pressure on Iran, saying 'we are paralyzing their economy' and that Iranian leaders lack urgency, tempering hopes of a quick deal
alerts.source: Trump remarks via Open Source Intel (Osint613) on X

alerts.headline: Diplomatic sources tell Lebanon's Al Jadeed a breakthrough has been reached in US-Iran negotiations after Qatari mediation overcame procedural obstacles (single-outlet report, no official confirmation)
alerts.source: Al Jadeed via LiveSquawk and Amena Bakr on X

alerts.headline: Explosion and large fire at HPCL's Visakh refinery in Visakhapatnam, India; fire tenders rushed in, cause and damage not yet known
alerts.source: Deccan Chronicle and multiple local reports on X

alerts.headline: Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree claims drone strikes on Saudi Arabia's Dammam airport in the oil-rich Eastern Province (two drones, saying air traffic was disrupted), plus an early-warning radar and a military transport aircraft in Jizan, over the past 48 hours; separately, Saudi Arabia reportedly said it intercepted two drones over Riyadh just after midnight. Damage unverified.
alerts.source: Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree (Arabic statement), via Open Source Intel and MenchOsint

alerts.headline: Kazakhstan says oil flows on the Atyrau-Samara pipeline have been halted, with some reports linking it to a drone attack; the line carries Kazakh crude into Russia's Transneft system via the Samara hub hit by Ukrainian drones earlier today.
alerts.source: Walter Bloomberg, FinancialJuice, CGTN Europe (Kazakhstan statement; drone cause unconfirmed)

alerts.headline: Explosions and gunfire reported at the British Embassy in Baghdad, per Iran's Tasnim news agency, a day after Iran designated the UK Royal Navy and RAF as terrorist organizations; cause and casualties unknown, no UK or Iraqi confirmation yet
alerts.source: Tasnim report, via War Radar, Walter Bloomberg (DeItaone) and UK_REPT

alerts.headline: Iran's President Pezeshkian says the Supreme Leader has granted the government authority over negotiations, a step toward talks with Washington; posts report crude falling about 5% on the news
alerts.source: Iranian President Pezeshkian, via IRNA, OSINT613 and Post Open Source

alerts.headline: Iran's navy says an oil tanker that had switched off its navigation and identification systems struck a naval mine in a restricted, unsafe area of the eastern Strait of Hormuz and caught fire; the vessel is not named and there is no independent confirmation
alerts.source: Iranian state media (IRIB), via FinancialJuice, LiveSquawk and CGTN

alerts.headline: IRGC claims 11 tankers have burned in the Strait of Hormuz since Oct 25, a much larger tally than the four it claimed earlier today; no independent confirmation
alerts.source: FirstSquawk (X)

alerts.headline: FirstSquawk: start of Iran-US negotiations depends on an end of the US naval blockade (speaker not named, apparently Iran's side), a further hardening of terms minutes after Iran said Hormuz cannot reopen before sanctions are lifted
alerts.source: FirstSquawk (X)

alerts.headline: Iran says the Strait of Hormuz cannot be reopened before US sanctions are lifted, hardening its terms just as oil fell on hopes for Qatar-led talks and a two-day reopening plan
alerts.source: First Squawk and FinancialJuice headlines

alerts.headline: UKMTO says a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz was hit by limpet mines, sparking an engine-room fire and temporarily disabling it; crew safe, no spill. Three maritime security sources name it as the Panama-flagged Louise 1
alerts.source: Adi Imsirovic, relaying UKMTO and maritime security sources

alerts.headline: IRGC Navy now claims four oil tankers caught fire and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz after using what it calls unauthorised routes, up from the two it reported earlier; no independent confirmation of the extra vessels
alerts.source: Ships & Ports, relaying an IRGC Navy claim

alerts.headline: Saudi Civil Defense sounds early warnings of possible danger in Abha, Khamis Mushait and Taif in southwest Saudi Arabia amid a reported Yemeni (Houthi) attack; small-account claims that oil facilities were targeted are unverified
alerts.source: Saudi Civil Defense via Al-Araby Al-Jadeed and Al Mayadeen

alerts.headline: Ukrainian drones hit Transneft's Samara crude pumping and dispatch station (LPDS Samara) in Prosvet, Samara Oblast, a key hub that blends crude into Urals export grade; a fire broke out. It is the third attack on the site in recent weeks, and damage is not yet known
alerts.source: Exilenova+, Charter97 (Russian), Mockingjay News UA; claim attributed to Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces

alerts.headline: WSJ: Washington is pushing to restore Russian gas flows to Europe via Ukraine, aiming to secure an energy truce between Moscow and Kyiv that could pause strikes on energy sites
alerts.source: WSJ report, relayed by LiveSquawk, First Squawk, RedboxGlobal and FinancialJuice

alerts.headline: UKMTO warning 192-26: a tanker heading southeast through the northern Gulf was struck on its port side by two unknown projectiles 72 nm east of Ras Al Khafji, Saudi Arabia; crew accounted for, no spill. OSINT accounts blame the IRGC, which is unconfirmed
alerts.source: UKMTO, relayed by Iran International English and NTC Report; IRGC attribution from AMK Mapping

alerts.eventTime: Overnight 1–2 Nov, roughly 12–5 am SGT 2 Nov (est.)
alerts.headline: Saudi-led coalition airstrikes hit Ras Isa, the Houthis' main fuel import terminal in Hodeidah, striking its pier and a docked ship plus an oil company station in Bajil; Houthi health ministry says 7 injured. Claims the port is out of service are unconfirmed
alerts.source: Houthi health ministry via Al Jazeera Now, Middle East Observer and Yemeni media

alerts.eventTime: Not stated (IRGC says 'today', 1 Nov Iran time)
alerts.headline: IRGC Navy says two oil tankers exploded after hitting naval mines while using an unauthorized route through the Strait of Hormuz with AIS off; it says one, a supertanker, is ablaze. UKMTO has not confirmed the blasts
alerts.source: IRNA (Iranian state news agency), relayed by Reuters and Roya News

alerts.headline: UKMTO Warning 191-26: a merchant vessel was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz after another ship relayed a Mayday; ships told to transit with caution
alerts.source: UKMTO Warning 191-26, via DC Global News

alerts.headline: Large fire at Lukoil's Kstovo refinery (NORSI, about 17 million tonnes a year) in Nizhny Novgorod region after an overnight Ukrainian drone attack, the third Russian refinery hit in three days; local fuel queues reported
alerts.source: UNN (Ukrainian, translated) and local footage

alerts.headline: Iran's Hormuz authority (PGSA) blanket enforcement against South Korean owner Sinokor's entire tanker fleet takes effect from 1 Nov; Sinokor carried about 37% of Hormuz oil transits in September and over half of VLCC traffic in early October
alerts.source: Persian Gulf Strait Authority notice of 27 Oct, via ZeroHedge (Lloyd's List data)

alerts.headline: Iran's security chief Rezaei says the Strait of Hormuz will stay closed until Tehran's conditions are fulfilled; Tehran has sent Washington seven conditions and says there will be no negotiation until they are met
alerts.source: Fars News, via FinancialJuice and Open Source Intel

alerts.headline: i24NEWS: the IDF has raised its alert level ahead of a possible resumption of joint US-Israeli military operations against Iran and is ready to enter the war within hours if a decision is made, though readiness has not peaked
alerts.source: i24NEWS, via Open Source Intel

alerts.headline: Iran's navy says an oil tanker caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz after colliding with naval mines, per Iranian state media; vessel not named and it is unclear whether this is a new incident
alerts.source: Iranian state media, via FinancialJuice and CGTN Africa

alerts.eventTime: Not stated (Kyiv Independent report, 12:34 am, 1 Nov)
alerts.headline: Ukrainian officials tell the Kyiv Independent the campaign of strikes on Russian oil refineries is ongoing, rejecting reports that Kyiv agreed to suspend it; no halt order was given despite US envoy Kushner's proposal for a 30-day pause
alerts.source: The Kyiv Independent (citing Ukrainian officials)

alerts.headline: OPEC+ agrees in principle to keep its December production targets unchanged, a source says
alerts.source: FinancialJuice, CGTN Europe, NodeWire (citing a source)

alerts.headline: Leaked draft of a preliminary Qatari-brokered US-Iran framework reportedly has Tehran handing its roughly 440 kg of highly enriched uranium to an agreed third country and reopening the Strait of Hormuz to shipping within 7 days; no final deal yet
alerts.source: Abdulrahman Al-Rashed (Arabic), Mostafa Gorji citing an Asharq Al-Awsat reporter (Persian), Abdulaziz Al Oqab (Arabic)

alerts.headline: Reports and new footage say a Kuwaiti oil tanker was targeted in the Strait of Hormuz today; the footage describes it as a 'violating ship' hit in the strait, and who carried out the strike was not stated
alerts.source: Post Open Source (via AB4_Ali3), Iraq Al-Hadath TV (Arabic), The Observer

alerts.headline: Araghchi tells Al Jazeera that a new proposal reached with Qatari mediators cuts the time to implement Iran's plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to two days (down from five, and seven before that); Tehran's conditions include lifting sanctions, fewer US forces in the region and recognition of the new shipping route
alerts.source: Araghchi via Al Jazeera Breaking News, also Iran International English and Entekhab (Persian)

dayNote.title: Today's key developments
lines: Explosions hit Iran's Qeshm Island, Bandar Abbas and waters off Bandar Lengeh, with heavy US aircraft activity over Hormuz and unconfirmed reports of US strikes and IRGC attacks on shipping.
Oil fell sharply as Trump said an Iran deal is coming together, but Axios says the CIA urges keeping pressure with no war and no deal, while Russia targets Ukraine's energy.
